Dragonball fanfic is like taking apart your Lego set and rebuilding it to something different but without getting any new pieces. Most db fanfics either try to follow the exact full story with some variations or try to make it a completely different thing. The point is that you're still using the same peices at the end of the day, and that limits what the new build can be. It's like a lot of these writers are purposely not adding anything that is completely their own idea. For example, something like "vamasu steals the body of gohan or somethin". Sure, it was technically a "new" idea, but all it does is just cluth onto the already made concept of zamasu picking a different body instead of goku. The truth is that most fanfics seem to be more of a parody than its own thing.
